needs_atom.missing: Two 'can't' prohibitions with no node or engine lane. (1) 'Creature cards in graveyards and libraries can't enter the battlefield.' needs a prohibition on a ZONE CHANGE (graveyard or library -> battlefield, creature cards, any controller): PREVENT_EFFECT over ZoneChangeEvent is accepted by the IR but nothing consumes it (executor/verbs.py _v_prevent registers it; replacements.py's prevention consumers cover damage, life gain, draw, counters, dies, untap, attack/block declaration and activation only), and ZoneChangeEvent.from_zone holds one zone, so 'graveyards and libraries' needs a zone set or two nodes. A ReplacementAbility has no 'do nothing' action. (2) 'Players can't cast spells from graveyards or libraries.' needs a cast prohibition by origin zone: no consumer in legality.py reads a PREVENT_EFFECT over CastSpellEvent(from_zone=...). Written as PREVENT_EFFECT statics, the card would silently do nothing. No compiled precedent in the 19 sets for either sentence.
